description: This tool reads what the webinar conversation has collected so far: topic, audience, date and how far the texts are. Nothing is created and no site is touched. Take it when you want to pick a conversation up where it stopped, for example when a host says "Where were we? I had already told you the topic." It needs the session id from an earlier turn, and with more than one connected site the site address too. It changes nothing. Words hosts use: session facts, topic, audience, where were we

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_get_session_facts
title: Read the collected webinar facts
